primary_goal: Encourage users to browse the menu, select food items, and add them to their cart to place an online food delivery order.

friction_points.issue: Multiple food images display prominent 'KI' (AI) watermarks, signaling synthetic food pictures rather than authentic dishes.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 18 display a small dark 'KI' tag in the bottom right corner of product photos (e.g. Pizza Spinaci, Spaghetti Bolognese, Veggi Pizzaburger).

friction_points.issue: Numerous menu items toward the bottom are missing images entirely or locked in permanent skeleton loading states.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 19 through 36 show empty beige image boxes for 'Glutenfreie Gerichte', 'Beilagen', 'Extras', and 'Dessert', followed by dozens of unrendered grey skeleton placeholders.

friction_points.issue: Frequent spelling mistakes and typos across item titles and descriptions degrade brand professionalism.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshot 18 titles entire section as 'Warp' instead of 'Wrap' ('Crispy Chicken Warp', 'Falafel Warp', 'BBQ Warp'). Screenshot 12 spells 'Champignons' as 'Champinos'. Screenshot 16 has 'Hänschenbrust', 'Sause', and 'Bacen'.

friction_points.issue: Delivery cost and minimum order value (Mindestbestellwert) are omitted from the header delivery badge.
friction_points.evidence: Header badge in Screenshot 1 only displays 'Lieferung 35-55 min' and 'Abholung 15 min' without clarifying delivery costs or minimum order thresholds.

friction_points.issue: Promotional discount banner text ends abruptly with an unformatted hyphen and lacks an actionable click/add button.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshot 1 shows yellow discount banner with the text '35 % Rabatt auf Zwiebelringe 250g -' ending with a floating dash.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we fix all orthographic errors in product titles and ingredient lists, then overall checkout conversion will improve because German consumers associate accurate language with high quality standards.
If we replace AI-generated food renderings with real photos of prepared dishes, then add-to-cart rates will increase because food appetitiveness and product trust will rise.
hypotheses.change: Upload real photos of dishes to replace images bearing the 'KI' badge.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we provide complete images and fix blank loading states in side dish and drink categories, then average order value (AOV) will increase because customers can visually evaluate cross-sell items.
hypotheses.change: Populate images for 'Beilagen', 'Glutenfrei', 'Dessert', and 'Getränke' categories instead of displaying blank beige placeholders.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add explicit delivery fee and minimum order value details directly in the top delivery toggle bar, then session drop-off will decrease because price transparency is established upfront.
hypotheses.change: Include 'ab X € | Liefergebühr Y €' next to the '35-55 min' delivery time indicator.

quick_wins: Rename the 'Wraps' category items from 'Warp' to 'Wrap'.
Fix spelling of 'Champignons', 'Sauce', and 'Bacon' in item descriptions.
Remove trailing hyphen from the yellow promotional banner '35 % Rabatt auf Zwiebelringe 250g -'.
uncertainties: Whether the infinite skeleton loading components at the bottom of the page were caused by a temporary API loading lag or missing menu data.
Exact delivery fee and minimum order amount applied at checkout for the user's specific location.
